postParagraphs: There is also a welcome offer for Proton Unlimited, with a very low price for the first month. It is a monthly plan and, from the second month on, it renews at the full monthly price. It works for trying the bundle for a month. To keep it for a year, the yearly plan costs less.

contentSections.heading: You pay for the whole period upfront
paragraphs: The headline price on the pages is "per month", but the whole period is billed at once. On the partner page's 2-year VPN Plus plan, $2.49 per month means $59.76 on your card statement.
The small line under each plan shows that total and the renewal price. Read that line before you click, and check the total again at checkout.

contentSections.heading: What happens at renewal
paragraphs: The campaign price covers the first period only. In the FAQ of its Black Friday pages, Proton says the subscription renews automatically at the standard price every billing cycle unless you cancel.

In the prices we read, VPN Plus renews at $83.88 every 12 months and Proton Unlimited at $119.88. Proton's terms say renewal follows the price in force on that date, so today's figure may change by then. To avoid renewing, cancel the renewal in your account dashboard before the date. Write the date down on the day you buy.

contentSections.heading: What the discount is measured against
paragraphs: According to Proton, all discounts are calculated on the regular monthly price, which was $9.99 for VPN Plus and $12.99 for Proton Unlimited. The 75% on the 2-year plan compares $59.76 with 24 monthly payments of $9.99, which add up to $239.76.

For a buying decision, compare the same plan and billing period. Our link showed $59.76 for 24 months against $71.76 on Proton's deals page, a $12 saving. The advertised 75% uses the monthly plan as its reference, rather than that 24-month offer.

postParagraphs: The 1-year plan asks for the least money today and suits someone who wants to try the paid service and may cancel before renewal. If the subscription runs into a second year, the renewal alone costs more than the whole 2-year plan on the partner page.

The two-year plan suits people who want the paid Plus features and expect to use them for the full term. For that buyer, our link had the lower total of the options compared; the free plan remains an option for people who do not need those features.
For Proton Unlimited, the partner page offered the 1-year plan at $77.88, renewing at $119.88 every 12 months.
contentSections.emphasis: By the numbers in the table, for anyone who wants VPN Plus for the full two years, the choice is the 2-year plan through our link, because it adds up to $59.76 over 24 months, against $119.76 for the 1-year plan plus one renewal.

contentSections.heading: VPN Plus alone or Proton Unlimited
paragraphs: VPN Plus is the paid VPN only: according to Proton, 10 devices at a time, servers in more than 140 countries and an ad and malware blocker. Subscribers keep the free plans for email, cloud storage and passwords.
Proton Unlimited bundles VPN Plus, Mail Plus, Drive Plus and Pass Plus, with 500 GB of storage. On the partner page it cost $77.88 for the first year and renewed at $119.88.

If you only need the paid VPN, choose VPN Plus. Proton does not allow multiple Plus subscriptions on the same account. Unlimited brings the paid VPN, email and storage features together with 500 GB in one account; choose it for the features and space you will use, and compare renewal costs.

contentSections.heading: Who can get it
paragraphs: The FAQ on the partner page and on the public pages says the offers are for all new users. According to the public pages, people who already have an account sign in to see their own special offers. Those cannot be seen without logging in.
Proton does not publish the date the campaign ends, on the public page or on the partner page. Do not count on a deadline. Check the price on the day you subscribe.

postParagraphs: Proton says it accepts Visa, Mastercard, American Express and PayPal.

contentSections.heading: If you do not like it: the refund
paragraphs: Proton's terms allow you to cancel within 30 days of the initial purchase and get the amount back. The request goes through the support form, and both the cancellation and the refund request must happen within those 30 days.

There are conditions. A refund can be requested only once per user and does not cover payments in cash or by bank transfer. The terms refer to people who subscribed directly through Proton's official channels (website and apps); anyone who subscribed through a third party follows that party's policy. We did not check subscriptions billed by a phone's app store. Through the link, the purchase happens on the website.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Does Proton have a discount coupon? There is no coupon: the Black Friday discount, up to 75% off, opens through Cecília's links, and the price shows on Proton's site, in your country's currency, with the renewal price next to it.

How much does Proton VPN cost on Black Friday? On the partner page, the 2-year VPN Plus plan cost $59.76, billed upfront, and renews at $83.88 every 12 months. Amounts change with your country and currency.
Does the Black Friday price apply at renewal? No. After the first period, the subscription renews at the standard price. In the prices we read, that is $83.88 every 12 months for VPN Plus.
Do existing Proton customers get a discount? The page says the offers are for new users. According to Proton, people who already have an account see their offers after signing in.
Can I ask for a refund? Yes, within 30 days of the initial purchase, through the support form, once per user and for subscriptions made through Proton's official channels.
